policy: Port the desktop macOS application. The rejected Windows preview and raw game-only scene are not an application reference. Shared game assets are permitted only as used by this macOS source. Mac 1.3.0 (build 19) is commit 29db6626154ca152b6f334846594bff0078aa965; the pinned commit's Sources tree is identical to it, and its Resources tree differs only by the windows platform added for HarmonyOS Sans in the shared Resources/Fonts/manifest.json (the Mac reads the macos platform only).
